stories.title: Riyadh Season 2026 to kick off on October 21

en.title: Riyadh Season 2026 to kick off on October 21
en.summary: Riyadh Season 2026, the seventh edition of the festival, will begin on October 21 and run for ten weeks featuring entertainment, sports, and cultural events under the "Big Time" slogan.

stories.title: New road lanes in Makkah cut travel times

en.title: New road lanes in Makkah cut travel times
en.summary: New lanes have opened on major roads in Makkah, including additional sections of the Third Ring Road and Prince Saud Al-Faisal Road, reducing travel times by over 90 percent on affected routes.

stories.title: NCM forecasts heavy rain, flash flood risk across parts of Saudi Arabia through Friday

en.title: NCM forecasts heavy rain, flash flood risk across parts of Saudi Arabia through Friday
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's National Center for Meteorology forecasts heavy rainfall across multiple regions through Friday, with risks of flash floods, strong winds, hail, and possible tornadoes in affected areas.

stories.title: The countdown is on — Riyadh Season 2026 is almost here!

en.title: The countdown is on — Riyadh Season 2026 is almost here!
en.summary: Riyadh Season 2026 will officially open on October 21 with a ten-week program of sports events, concerts, and theatrical performances aimed at strengthening Riyadh's global event destination status.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Participates in G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting on Ebola Response

en.title: Saudi Arabia Participates in G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting on Ebola Response
en.summary: Saudi Arabia took part in a G20 foreign ministers' meeting focused on coordinating responses to Ebola.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia’s renewable energy pipeline reaches 63.8 GW across 53 projects

en.title: Saudi Arabia's renewable energy pipeline reaches 63.8 GW across 53 projects
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has 63.8 gigawatts of renewable energy across 53 projects in development as it pursues net-zero emissions by 2060. The kingdom's operating renewable capacity has grown over 63-fold since 2020 to reach 19.3 GW in 2026.

stories.title: GEA Chairman Announces October 21 Launch for Riyadh Season 2026

en.title: GEA Chairman Announces October 21 Launch for Riyadh Season 2026
en.summary: The chairman of GEA announced that Riyadh Season 2026 will launch on October 21.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia calls for protection of international waterways, rejects restrictions on navigation

en.title: Saudi Arabia calls for protection of international waterways, rejects restrictions on navigation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's foreign minister addressed the UN General Assembly, emphasizing the importance of maintaining freedom of navigation in key waterways including the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea, and rejecting any restrictions or fees imposed by other parties.

stories.title: New road lanes open in Makkah to ease traffic congestion

en.title: New road lanes open in Makkah to ease traffic congestion
en.summary: The Royal Commission for Makkah City opened newly developed traffic lanes on the Third Ring Road and Prince Saud Al Faisal Road, with a 1.5-kilometer expansion reducing travel times by over 90 percent.

stories.title: International Conference on Saudi Arabia’s Efforts to Counter Intellectual Deviations Kicks Off Monday

en.title: International Conference on Saudi Arabia's Efforts to Counter Intellectual Deviations Kicks Off Monday
en.summary: An international conference addressing Saudi Arabia's initiatives to counter intellectual deviations is beginning on Monday.

en.title: New Road Lanes Open in Makkah to Ease Congestion, Aid Pilgrims
en.summary: Additional road lanes have opened in Makkah to reduce traffic congestion and support pilgrims.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Distributes Shelter Aid to over 3,100 Displaced People Across Six Yemeni Governorates

en.title: Saudi Arabia Distributes Shelter Aid to over 3,100 Displaced People Across Six Yemeni Governorates
en.summary: Saudi Arabia provided shelter assistance to more than 3,100 displaced individuals across six governorates in Yemen.

en.title: Foreign institutions sell SAR 1.19B on TASI
en.summary: Foreign institutions were net sellers of approximately 1.19 billion Saudi riyals on the Saudi Exchange during the week ending September 24, while local institutional investors bought shares.

stories.title: ‎Tadawul lifts trading suspension on National Gypsum

en.title: Tadawul lifts trading suspension on National Gypsum
en.summary: Saudi Exchange lifted its trading suspension on National Gypsum Co. shares effective September 28, following the company's submission of its first-half 2026 financial statements after missing the regulatory deadline.

stories.title: ‎CMA seeks feedback on foreign market trading rules

en.title: CMA seeks feedback on foreign market trading rules
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Capital Market Authority is consulting stakeholders for 30 days on draft regulations governing how capital market institutions conduct business in foreign financial markets, including new suitability requirements.

stories.title: ‎SAIB, Aldrees board member Mohammed Mussa passes away

en.title: SAIB, Aldrees board member Mohammed Mussa passes away
en.summary: Mohammed Mussa, a board member at Saudi Investment Bank and an independent board member at Aldrees Petroleum and Transport Services Co., passed away on September 26.

stories.title: ‎Al Kathiri files for CMA approval on capital reduction

en.title: Al Kathiri files for CMA approval on capital reduction
en.summary: Al Kathiri Holding Co. requested Capital Market Authority approval to reduce its capital from SAR 113.02 million to SAR 9.65 million by canceling shares, aiming to restructure capital and offset accumulated losses.
